Overview

Chemnitz is a city in Saxony with a population of 245,000. A Saxon city of industry and culture, reinventing itself with a striking art scene, affordable living, and the European Capital of Culture legacy. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
